mapper.sql: create_time, update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, name, report_type, inspect_type, type, product_type
mapper.select: SELECT *, CASE product_type WHEN 1 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 3 WHEN 16 THEN 2 END task_type_enum_sort FROM mes_building_process WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND id IN ( SELECT team.process_id FROM mes_building_workshop workshop LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line line ON line.workshop_id = workshop.id AND line.production_line_type_enum=1 and line.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_team team ON team.production_line_id = line.id AND team.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE workshop.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND workshop.id = #{workshopId}) ORDER BY task_type_enum_sort ASC, sort ASC
